title: Activity freshness
responsibility: Determines which registered agents a sampled roster can still describe as working.

inputs.name: activityReading.agents
inputs.description: Roster and its reported working count.

inputs.name: activityReading.now
inputs.description: Current time in milliseconds since the epoch.

outputs.name: activityReading
outputs.description: Returns whether the reading is at most one minute old, a working count reduced by expired working entries or null when unknown/old, and a labeling function. Finished states retain their labels; old working observations become Not confirmed and individually expired ones become Stale.
